'''2638''' was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] that operated during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] as a member of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] served in the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]].

==Behind the scenes==
This [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid's]] identification number, 2638, can be spotted on its back, in a similar manner to [[1138 (Trade Federation)/Legends|1138]], a droid from [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].
